github_actions.notes: Use only within repository/account quota; no paid model API.

cloudflare.notes: Workers Free; Workers AI free allocation must fail closed when exhausted.

render.notes: Free web service may sleep/suspend; ephemeral filesystem.

vercel.notes: Hobby only; never enable Pro or usage purchase.

netlify.notes: Free plan has a hard monthly credit limit and no auto recharge.

supabase.notes: Free plan only; no paid add-ons or upgrade.

excluded_or_restricted.digitalocean: payment method required for intended compute path
excluded_or_restricted.deno_deploy: unverified/restricted no-card allowance; full Free limits require card verification
excluded_or_restricted.huggingface_compute_spaces: compute Space creation requires paid plan as of 2026
excluded_or_restricted.floot: interface/status repository only; not a compute provider
excluded_or_restricted.scaleway: not approved until no-card zero-euro path is verified
excluded_or_restricted.alibaba: not approved until no-card zero-euro path is verified
